lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gill slits, with primary nodes arranged in groups of 4-5 per vertical alignment.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Intersections of faint vertical bands and horizontal lines of elevated pixel intensity forming a grid, with circular blobs serving as anchor nodes at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal ridge running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a high-intensity upper edge to a low-intensity lower shadow.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of approximately 5-7 high-luminance blobs within the boundary of the visible dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A sharp transition in spot morphology from large, grid-aligned nodes on the mid-lateral flank to small, high-density, randomly distributed clusters towards the anterior cephalic region.
